policies.title: Pakistani ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule places Pakistan in its Prior to Arrival cohort, which it defines as mission or consulate issuance before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Pakistani ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Pakistani ordinary passports: Mongolia electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Mongolia's live official portal lists Pakistan, accepts the application and payment online, and sends approval electronically before border scanning.
conditions: Applies to a Pakistani ordinary passport holder using Mongolia's short tourist eVisa route.
Apply and pay online, receive the approved document by email before travel, and carry it for scanning at the immigration check post.
Approval does not guarantee admission; work, residence, other visa classes and special documents remain outside scope.

application.label: Mongolia eVisa application
application.processingTime: The Immigration Agency says applications are processed within three working days or 72 hours.
steps: Start an application and select Pakistan, ordinary passport and the tourist eVisa category.
Complete the form, upload the required documents and pay online.
Receive the approved electronic document by email and carry it for arrival scanning.

policies.title: Pakistani ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy guidance places Pakistan in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring approval before travel unless a separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to a Pakistani ordinary passport holder who does not independently qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
The authorized-visa process may take up to 60 business days and must be completed before travel.
Transit, work, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Pakistani ordinary passports: Türkiye baseline advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry schedule requires Pakistani ordinary passports to hold a visa; eVisa access depends on a separate qualifying Schengen, U.S., UK or Irish visa or residence permit.
conditions: Applies to the nationality-wide baseline for a Pakistani ordinary passport holder travelling for a short visit.
A one-month single-entry eVisa is available only when the traveler also holds a qualifying Schengen, U.S., UK or Irish visa or residence permit.
That third-country-document route is conditional and does not replace the passport-only baseline; work, residence and final admission remain outside scope.

Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry schedule expressly requires Pakistani ordinary passports to have a visa; its eVisa route requires separate qualifying third-country documents.
